name: mroosz/php-cassandra-doc-tools
description: Isolated toolchain for generating the API reference (see scripts/build-api-doc.sh). Kept out of the root composer.json because phpDocumentor pins symfony ^6, which conflicts with the symfony ^7 packages used by php-cs-fixer and friends.

_comments.league/uri: Pinned to 7.5: from 7.8 on, resolving a relative DSN against the config file location throws 'The base URI must be an absolute URI', which breaks every phpdoc run driven by phpdoc.dist.xml.
